preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, the number of cities n must be between 2 and 3000.
The total number of cities across all test cases must not exceed 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two valid cities within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the minimum possible number of roads assigned to the most used company.
The second line of the output must contain exactly n-1 company numbers corresponding to the roads.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 10**6 for c_i in map(int, stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: Each company number in the output must be between 1 and 10^6.
